scope: Mara Year One Mine campaign only: sealed Godbridle custody case, ground pose, carrier keeper, and explicit tactical alternate; not the wider battlefield or character placeholder
author: Asset author

evidence.godot_context: Independent matched Godot review of exact editor-imported hero pickup and carry, orthographic tactical command view, and the original proxy baseline under the same scene and cameras.
evidence.close_up: Independent near-hero ground, side keeper contact, seal detail, neutral front and reverse. Hashes below name the off-repository evidence.
evidence.motion: Real Mine mission pickup, traveled carry, tactical transition, terminal loss and restart, plus 48 frames of close inspection while the real carrier moves. Existing pickup state switch, not a new hand animation. An art-only drop/re-lift study is separate from the game.
evidence.reproduction: Godot 4.7.2, Compatibility, Mesa llvmpipe 1280×720. Import the project, run tests/godbridle_case_visual.gd, launch the Mara Mine campaign scene, approach GodbridlePickup from the southwest, press Space or Cross, move with the closed case and hold/release Shift or L2 to compare tactical and hero. A terminal-loss report hides the case; Backspace restarts the same attempt.
evidence.measurements: Four marker-on/off renders changed 0 of 184,160 case-dependent pixels. Same-camera tactical near/far each covered the same 7 changed pixels. Interleaved ABBA hero draws 494→490 and 116,172→126,738 submitted primitives; tactical 192→186 and 8,098→6,962. Timing drift in software, no console FPS assertion.

shape_and_craft.finding: An intact sealed case, not an exposed relic. Clean footing and case/keeper fit, visible strap connections, readable shaped lid and forged hardware under close inspection.

materials_and_lighting.finding: Differentiated walnut, leather, bronze and pressed wax. Real hero and neutral faces are coherent; the existing emissive beacon does not bleed onto or mask case pixels in the matched test.

readability_in_play.finding: The hero camera distinguishes the carry case. The command camera retains the tactical footprint, existing marker/label and minimap; only the case visual alternates.

motion_and_effects.finding: Actual movement, pickup, pose contact, near/tactical swaps, terminal loss, restart and tight moving mount evidence. The intentional cord tail remains attached under the wax; no keeper in the grounded or tactical poses.

integration_and_cost.finding: Editor import embeds maps; explicit mutually exclusive LODs. Clean launch and focused actual input/regression evidence. Single-object budget passes; not a console-performance claim.

integration_scope.note: These historical hashes record the campaign-only binding at review; unlike the durable visual files, they do not assert future gameplay scripts remain identical. Recheck relevant anchor, state visibility, lighting and camera context if they change.
